initial_runtime_fixture.conclusion: Second registration invokes the already installed write hook after its original pointer has been replaced by a newly prepared, still non-executable trampoline. This failure does not validate or invalidate candidate QQ offsets.

early_napi_runtime_probe.fixture: Called the retained Napi initHook synchronously inside the process.dlopen wrapper immediately after the first module load returned.

early_napi_runtime_probe.native_precondition: HookManager init_send_hook and init_recv_hook obtain wrapper.node dlpi_addr and do not reject an absent zero base before adding the requested RVA.
early_napi_runtime_probe.failure: SIGSEGV with the first-load immediate probe; no core was retained.
early_napi_runtime_probe.conclusion: Do not initialize packet hooks as part of loading the native addon. Preserve the normal wrapper-before-hook order.

successful_runtime_verification.napi_probe_order: Preserved exports from its first native load, then initialized after normal wrapper and engine startup; the diagnostic fixture used a 10-second delay.
successful_runtime_verification.production_initialization_order: Load addons once, load wrapper.node, and initialize packet hooks at their existing lifecycle stages. Keep Napi initialization in the normal PacketApi initialization flow; a fixed timer is not a production readiness rule.
